evidenceRules.sourceReview: Separate source intent from actual runtime proof.
evidenceRules.missingEvidence: Unobserved / missing evidence is distinct from pass/fail. Broken evidence acquisition does not prove product absence.
evidenceRules.negativeAction: Native disabled state plus rejected activation/no callback is valid; script failure before activation is missing evidence.
evidenceRules.scroll: scroll_until uses ordinary parent gestures only; record progression, allow extra gestures; never invoke handlers directly.
evidenceRules.nativeDifference: Record actual Apple accessibility category for requested scales; grade content/hierarchy, not identical line breaks.
evidenceRules.callback: No event during render/update; exactly one per enabled activation; bridge echoes only selection/consent.

sourceReviewChecks.expected: New public API/models; Swift Codable/public init; compile iOS14/macOS11; existing Compose dependencies.
No competing cached selection/consent; derive validity from current model.
Native controls/IDs/state and target minimum sizes; declarations are not runtime exposure proof.
Flexible wrapping and supported font scaling; no line-limit/ellipsis/shrink-to-fit.
Content-growing panel with no nested/fixed-height scroll viewport.
Theme-aware colors and semantic native leading/trailing direction.

visualRubric.5: Reference hierarchy, spacing, colors; complete readable content; normal native differences.
visualRubric.4: Minor cosmetic deviations with no material hierarchy/readability harm.
visualRubric.3: Material hierarchy/spacing/color deviation but usable content/actions.
visualRubric.2: Severe clipping/overlap/contrast/layout disruption obscures important information/action.
visualRubric.1: Intended state largely absent or unusable.
visualRubric.missing: No screenshot -> unscored; callback-only defects do not automatically lower visual score.

measurement.caseRuleUnit: One platform × case × public rule; any observed required-checkpoint failure fails the pair; retain all evidence. Source-only R01 is separate, not multiplied per case.
measurement.report: Separate initial/holdout, platform, source/runtime, pass/fail/unobserved and observed denominator.
measurement.defectClusters: Count distinct demonstrated shared implementation causes separately from case×rule manifestations. Do not count each case as a new root cause.
measurement.detectionVsAttribution: Detailed shared-cause observation can count cluster detection without crediting every related exact rule. Attribute only explicitly identified supported rule violations.

scroll_until.identifier: native target ID; operator performs ordinary parent gestures
